findings.title: Derivation records the input profile digest but rewrites the bundled profile bytes
findings.evidence: tools/qore.py:215 records profile_info.sha256 = digest(profile_path), but tools/qore.py:235 writes references/project.json through write_json (indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, trailing newline). With compact JSON of profiles/qore.json, derive succeeds and manifest profile.sha256 is 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f, while bundled references/project.json and its successful bundled project-check.py report da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9. /workspace/implementation-review/evidence/correctness-probes.txt retains output; /tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs contains inputs/derivative.
findings.counterexample: Serialize profiles/qore.json with json.dumps(profile,separators=(comma,colon)); derive using current root into unused external temp; compare returned profile.sha256 and SHA-256 of qore-review-qore/references/project.json. Actual different hashes despite verify success. Expected released profile identity to identify the actual consumed bundled bytes or explicitly distinguish source_profile_sha256 from bundled profile sha256.

findings.title: Unchanged failing gates bypass the promised three-comparison plateau stop
findings.evidence: skills/qore-ux-review/scripts/stop-rule.mjs:84 checks stuck >= 2 before plateau >= 3 at line 85. Four measured iterations n=1..4 with G1=3 return decision CHANGE_APPROACH, stuck_count=3, no_improve_count=3 rather than STOP_PLATEAU. skills/qore-ux-review/references/protocol.md says after three comparisons without improvement the loop stops at plateau. Input /tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs/plateau.json; output correctness-probes.txt.
findings.counterexample: node skills/qore-ux-review/scripts/stop-rule.mjs /tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs/plateau.json returns CHANGE_APPROACH at iteration 4, although three unchanged comparisons have completed.

findings.title: Spec validation counts literal docstring text as executable acceptance steps
findings.evidence: skills/qore-plan/scripts/spec-lint.mjs:44-48 scans every Gherkin line for Given/When/Then without tracking docstrings. /tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs/docstring-spec.md has one real Given step and When/Then solely inside its triple-quoted argument. node spec-lint.mjs FILE --json exits 0 with valid:true and no problems. The artifact contract requires real acceptance scenarios with their own Given, When, Then. An additional Scenario Outline using placeholders without Examples also exits 0 (/tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs/outline-spec.md).
findings.counterexample: Run node skills/qore-plan/scripts/spec-lint.mjs /tmp/qore-correctness-zihl6vcs/docstring-spec.md --json. Actual valid:true; expected rejection because literal argument text contains the only When and Then.

findings.title: Inherited object properties can satisfy missing UX measurements
findings.evidence: skills/qore-ux-review/scripts/stop-rule.mjs:11 accepts any nonempty gate string; line 22 uses ordinary objects for measuredAt/measuredScores; lines 59-62 read inherited properties as measurements. Running node stop-rule.mjs against {"in_scope":["toString"],"iterations":[{"n":1,"scores":{},"measured":[]}]} returned exit 0, decision SHIP, coverage COMPLETE, missing_gates []. Exact command/input/stdout: /workspace/implementation-review/evidence/security-counterexamples.json.

findings.title: Derived release profile identity hashes the input bytes rather than the bundled profile
findings.evidence: tools/qore.py:215 records digest(profile_path), but line 235 calls write_json on the parsed profile. With the compact valid profile saved as feasibility-compact-profile.json, derive succeeds and verify returns valid, while manifest profile.sha256 is 63c9157e3dd4d6eb2c33c899820422e8ce1d1bee9cc4e22c1df96d814e50a83f and bundled references/project.json / runtime checker profile.sha256 is da03026c9f73a7771cc35aaaff898a3b970fed75362ebfd0c670068d6b23b3d9. See feasibility-derive-result.json and feasibility-project-check-result.txt.

findings.title: Findings gate accepts CONFIRMED lower-severity findings without the required counterexample
findings.evidence: skills/qore-review/references/findings.md:18 requires counterexample support for CONFIRMED, and :26 says validation checks verdict obligations. scripts/finding-lint.mjs:40 applies that obligation only to critical/high. The saved feasibility-medium-without-counterexample.json has a medium CONFIRMED finding and no counterexample; node finding-lint.mjs INPUT --verifier=ran --json exits 0 and emits valid:true, coverage:COMPLETE, verdict:SHIP. See feasibility-medium-lint-result.txt.
